llizell-pdp-audit-root.description: Research-backed UX and conversion audit of ecommerce product detail pages (PDPs). Use this skill whenever the user wants to review, audit, critique, or improve a product page — including requests like "review this PDP", "audit my product page", "why isn't this page converting", "UX review of [URL]", "check this product page against best practices", or when the user shares a product page URL or screenshots and asks for feedback. Also trigger for CRO reviews, conversion audits, or design QA of product pages, even if the words "audit" or "PDP" are not used.
